title: Presidential Candidates Step Up Campaign with Interviews and Street Rallies This Wednesday
subtitle: Podcasts, Radio, and TV Interviews Complement Caravans and Leafleting on Wednesday (16)
excerpt: On Wednesday (16), presidential candidates engaged in interviews across podcasts, radio, and TV, while also conducting caravans, distributing leaflets, and holding campaign rallies.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Wednesday (16), the presidential candidates' agendas featured a blend of interviews across different media and in-person campaign activities.

The hopefuls granted interviews to podcasts, radio shows, and television stations, aiming to broaden their media footprint and connect with voters across multiple platforms.

Concurrently, the day also saw candidates holding caravans, distributing leaflets, and engaging in other campaign events, reinforcing their strategy of direct public engagement.

With information from Agência Brasil.
